Hi Lydia,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, I'm drafting the proposed invoicing cadence and an initial payment on‑ramp to cover your annual committed spend.

High-level proposal (flexible):
- Activation deposit: $250,000 invoice upon contract signature / PO approval (to be wired within 10 business days)
- Remaining committed balance ($1,000,000) split into: 3 scheduled invoices across the year (Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1) tied to usage thresholds, with ability to draw against prepay for overage.
- Invoice terms: Net30 by default; open to Net45 for AP teams with justified processing window.
- Tax: Please confirm the billing entity and VAT ID if invoicing to an EU entity; for US entity we'll provide W9 and applicable state tax treatment.

Attached: Redwood_Invoice_Schedule_v2.xlsx (sample phasing), SOW-BLH-2026.pdf

Action items for BrightLayer:
1) Confirm billing entity name & tax/VAT ID
2) Confirm PO number and preferred invoice start date (we tentatively plan the Activation invoice for next Tuesday, Oct 6)
3) Share AP contact and any vendor onboarding forms we should complete

If you can confirm the three items by end of week, we'll finalize the schedule and route to Finance for issuance.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
